method: Per-host review of the advertising rules that predate the self-owned rebuild. These entered in commit 78c939c, audited at the time but without a machine-readable record. Their criterion 1 and 2 evidence — which capture observed them, and whether they were third-party to an observing origin — was never committed and cannot be reconstructed after the fact, so claiming an admission route for them would be an assertion, not evidence. Each is instead re-reviewed here against criteria 3 and 4 only, and this file is a closed grandfathered set: it may shrink, never grow. A new rule cannot be admitted through it, because the mapping test treats membership here as evidence only for the exact hosts enumerated below. adash.man.aliyuncs.com is kept although it does not resolve, because it holds an ordering contract against the aliyuncs.com cloud policy that the test suite asserts.
